title: Pods: one execution boundary through ape-shell
goal: Remove mail domain logic and parallel program authorization from Pods while preserving existing execution safeguards.
summary: Pods forwards program calls to ape-shell; ape-shell authorizes and executes them through one shared path. Mail behavior moves to independently delivered mail tools and scripts, while the IdP owns grant interpretation and presentation. Existing approvals and uncertain effects receive an explicit migration without replay.

problem.statement: Pods contains mail-specific behavior and several independent program authorization paths.
problem.impact: Security checks can diverge and mail changes require a desktop release.
problem.approach: Extend ape-shell -c as the forwarding entry point, relocate domain logic and preserve each safeguard at an explicit boundary.
problem.outcome: Every Pod-controlled program call uses ape-shell, and mail behavior changes without rebuilding Pods.

context: Source inspection used local main 2d24afe92c3dc3f994ba626c93e725ea90ac01b0. The installed desktop, active Pod scripts and live IdP were not inventoried. Patrick requested this plan and selected the architectural direction; the implementation proposal itself has not yet been approved. No product changes or runtime tests were performed for this plan.
scope: All Pod-controlled program entry points: scripts, tools.invoke, agent tools, terminals, application launches, recipe helpers and dependency/runtime launches. Inventory fixed bootstrap processes separately so they cannot become an alternative user-command path.

Remove mail-specific execution, approval, ingestion, extraction, classification and presentation logic from the Pods runtime. Mail examples and adapters may remain as separately delivered recipe assets, not runtime branches.
IdP grant presentation and command resolution; shared ape-shell execution; generic Pods supervision, effect records and recovery; migration of active recipes, stored data and open decisions.
nonGoals: No expansion of owner/isolated sandbox permissions, no automatic approvals, no new mail-provider features and no redesign of unrelated HTTP/SSH authorization. HTTP access must not become a mail-execution bypass.

This is a proposal, not authorization to migrate production, send messages, move live mail or install a desktop build. Do not claim arbitrary child processes are individually intercepted merely because their parent was started through ape-shell.

decisions.title: Make ape-shell -c simple for callers
decisions.description: Prefer extending the existing -c entry point and shared authorization/execution core. Prototype lossless argument transport, cancellation, PTY and sandbox integration before fixing CLI syntax. If text transport cannot preserve exact argv, add a structured mode in the same ape-shell path, not a Pods-side executor.
decisions.reference: können wir ape-shell -c nicht so bauen dass es als einfaches weiterreichen funktioniert?

decisions.title: No implicit increase in authority
decisions.description: An exact program request must never fall back to a shell-session grant. Intentional shell code remains a distinct, explicitly authorized request through the same ape-shell core. Neither a claimed read-only action nor script-provided display text can reduce the required permission.

sections.title: Target architecture and -c contract
sections.body:
`Pod / script / agent / terminal → generic Pods launcher → ape-shell → IdP authorization → ape-shell execution → native sandbox/supervisor → program`

Pods forwards executable/argv, assigned identity, target host, working directory, bounded environment and sandbox context. ape-shell owns authorization, token verification, single-use consumption and the transition to process execution; Pods observes progress and records generic effects. Keep the trusted control channel separate from program stdout so child output cannot forge an authorized/not-started receipt.

`-c` is the preferred public entry point, not an already sufficient security contract. A machine request must remain an exact program request even if arguments contain shell punctuation. Prototype safe text encoding first; if it cannot meet the contract, use a structured request over the same entry point/core. A shell-text request is explicitly typed and authorized as such. Do not invent the final flag syntax before M1.

`bash -c` only interprets and executes shell text. ape-shell adds authorization; it may internally start a program directly or execute explicitly approved shell text with Bash. Interpreters such as Node are allowed. Authorization must cover the concrete invocation, including the interpreter identity, exact arguments and the inline code or script content that will execute. For `node -e "console.log(2 + 2)"`, the code is part of the authorized arguments. For `node script.js`, the script content must also be bound, for example by a verified content hash; authorizing only the interpreter binary and script path is insufficient. Changed inline code or script content is not covered by the earlier exact-call approval. Verify the binding at execution so a file change after approval cannot substitute unapproved code. A native wrapper such as sandbox-exec must likewise preserve the binding to the actual target program.

Mail tools perform mail-specific preflight and effects. The IdP renders canonical adapter-resolved intent plus clearly marked script context; changing display text never changes the authorized command. Nonblocking requests, batch decisions and pending progress remain available through the shared ape-shell/IdP contract, not Pods-owned grants.

sections.title: Safeguards and their future owners
sections.body:
| Existing safeguard | Future owner and proof |
|---|---|
| Pod identity, owner/broker binding, audience, host and expiry | IdP issues; ape-shell verifies. Wrong identity/host/issuer and stale tokens refuse execution. |
| Exact argv, program hash, runtime and entry-file binding | Shared ape-shell execution contract plus trusted sandbox launcher. Changed file, runtime, argument or symlink refuses before start; preserve or strengthen current race protection. |
| Assigned applications, capabilities, directories and network reach | Pods supplies generic resource constraints; native sandbox enforces. ape-shell cannot expand them. |
| Single-use authorization and concurrent duplicate calls | IdP consumption plus ape-shell; durable generic operation identity in Pods prevents replay. |
| Per-message/object authorization | Mail command includes canonical object/version intent; IdP binds it and ape-shell enforces it. Broad read/program grants cannot substitute. |
| Fresh mail content, sender, subject, source folder and destination | Mail program/recipe checks immediately before mutation; stale or mismatched mail remains unchanged. |
| Receipt validation and mailbox-wide unresolved moves | Mail tool preserves provider receipts and durable message-level reconciliation across Pods and versions. Generic Pods ledger retains unknown outcomes. |
| No automatic retry after uncertain writes | Generic effect ledger before dispatch; interrupted, timed-out or failed writes stay unknown until reconciled. |
| Grant revocation, cancellation and long-running processes | Shared ape-shell lifecycle with native process-tree supervision; preserve current revocation checks and bounded token reuse. |
| Secret isolation, output bounds and failure reporting | Generic credential context and supervisor; no owner-auth fallback, token leakage or truncated successful result. |

No new generic API may accept `approved: true` from a Pod or treat its self-declared effect classification as authority. IdP-authorized semantics determine read/write classification; unknown commands are conservatively writes.

sections.title: Source map and implementation order
sections.body:
Baseline paths in `openape-monorepo`:

- Pods approvals and domain logic: `apps/openape-pods/src/contracts/approvals.ts`, `src/worker/data/approvals.ts`, `src/worker/data/mail-archive.ts`, `src/main/gates/`, `src/main/mail/`, `src/worker/mail/`, `src/worker/runs/dispatcher.ts`, `src/worker/master/reference.ts`.
- Execution: `apps/openape-pods/src/main/programs/`, `src/main/broker/`, `src/main/shell/`, `src/worker/runtime/`, `src/runtime/shell-client.ts`; `packages/agent-runtime/src/agent-tools/ape-shell-exec.ts`.
- ape-shell: `packages/apes/src/commands/run.ts`, `src/shell/grant-dispatch.ts`, `src/shell/program-line.ts`, `src/authorization/program.ts`, `src/authorization/execute.ts`.
- IdP: `modules/nuxt-auth-idp/src/runtime/server/api/grants/authorize.post.ts`, `src/runtime/server/utils/program-authorize.ts`, grant summary/rendering and the production IdP app.
- Mail distribution clues: `apps/openape-pods/runtime-sources/o365-cli.json`, `scripts/o365-runtime.mjs`, examples and test adapters. These are not proof of the canonical external mail source; resolve it in M0 and read that repository's instructions.

Dependency order: M0 → M1 → M2/M3 → M4 → M5. M2 and M3 can be separate PR increments; no dual active authorization route may be left as a permanent compatibility mechanism. Protocol-relevant contract changes require comparison with the canonical protocol specification before implementation. No protocol change is assumed approved by this plan request.

sections.title: Commands, working state and approval boundary
sections.body:
In every implementation shell start from the selected worktree:

```sh
. ./scripts/activate-node.sh
pnpm run doctor
```

Select existing focused suites after M0. Confirmed Pods scripts include `pnpm --filter @openape/pods test:fast`, `pnpm --filter @openape/pods build` and `pnpm --filter @openape/pods test:boundaries` (native). Run the required `pnpm check:affected --base origin/main --head HEAD --suite unit` once at the pre-push gate; do not duplicate the full gate during every iteration. A deployment requires `pnpm check:ci`. CI automation remains paused under the existing owner decision; do not reactivate it.

Plan source: `.claude/plans/2026-10-15-pods-ape-shell/plan.json`. Render with `ape-report-render plan INPUT.json OUTPUT.html --json`; publish privately in category Plans, retaining the same document for revisions and the read expected version. Record actual implementation approval against the reviewed proposal revision. The owner's architectural instruction is recorded as a decision, not as approval of this newly authored proposal.

Estimated scope: several implementation increments across CLI, desktop, IdP and mail tools. A reliable effort estimate follows M0/M1 because the active recipe migration and current shell contract are not yet measured.

milestones.title: Inventory execution paths and migration state
milestones.goal: Establish a complete boundary map and a safeguard baseline before implementation.
steps: Trace callers of spawn/exec, launchSandbox, launchTerminal, tools.invoke, agent tools, program.run, mail.archive and mail.next/commit, including master/runtime/dependency helpers. Classify every entry as a Pod-controlled execution or fixed infrastructure bootstrap with an explicit reason.

Read installed build versions and active recipe/resource metadata without running Pods. Inventory open, consumed and unknown approvals/effects, legacy archives, data schemas and API consumers. Identify the maintained mail-tool source and repository before moving code.
acceptance: Every discovered process entry and each existing safeguard has an owner, test and migration disposition; no unknown path is silently exempted.
milestones.rollback: Read-only inventory; preserve original records and avoid executing scheduled work.

milestones.title: Prove simple forwarding through ape-shell -c
milestones.goal: Make one exact program request use ape-shell authorization and sandboxed execution end to end.
steps: Extend the existing -c path using packages/apes/src/authorization/program.ts and execute.ts. Define a versioned machine request/result contract and a trusted progress channel; support pending, refused, not-started, started and unknown outcomes. Prefer existing CLI behavior; add structured transport only if the argument tests require it.

Prototype runtime-prefix and entry-file binding, Pod identity/broker claims, cwd/env, sandbox policy, output limits, PTY, cancellation and descendant termination. Reuse one authorization core for interactive and machine entry points; no preauthorization boolean from Pods.
acceptance: A synthetic program runs exactly once after approval. Denied, unanswered, timed-out, malformed, revoked and mismatched requests create neither the process marker nor the effect. Shell punctuation in a literal argument never requests wider authority.
Record the final -c syntax and transport decision with native execution evidence. If the approach cannot preserve the safety matrix, revise this plan before proceeding.

An approved node -e invocation executes its exact inline code. Changed inline code is refused under that approval. An approved node script.js invocation binds the script content; changed content at the same path, including replacement after approval, is refused before execution. These cases pass through the same ape-shell path as other programs.
milestones.rollback: Keep the prototype isolated and leave installed Pods unchanged.

milestones.title: Route every program entry through the shared core
milestones.goal: Reduce Pods to generic forwarding, resource boundaries and effect supervision.
steps: Replace direct program authorization and launch paths in broker/tools.ts, programs/invoke.ts, programs/session.ts, shell/session.ts, worker runners and agent-tool bridges. Preserve assigned application selection, runtime verification and sandbox enforcement. Route helper programs and runtime work according to M0; keep fixed bootstrap infrastructure non-programmable.

Use opaque operation IDs and authenticated lifecycle results for the generic effect ledger. Preserve pending/resume, concurrent once-use, crash recovery, revocation behavior and conservative handling of unknown writes.
acceptance: Each M0 entry point passes both success and refusal tests through ape-shell. A structural check rejects new direct user-program launch or authorization paths in Pods.
milestones.rollback: Before production cutover, retain a tested old build for whole-version recovery; never add an automatic per-call fallback to the old path.

milestones.title: Relocate mail behavior and IdP presentation
milestones.goal: Preserve mail functionality and object-level protection without desktop domain code.
steps: Move archival preflight, provider parsing, receipts, object/version checks and mailbox-wide reconciliation to the maintained mail tool. Move mail intake, extraction, classification and orchestration to mail tools/recipes; use generic data and execution APIs from Pods. Avoid merely renaming mail code or bundling it back into the desktop.

Define adapter commands that bind mailbox, message identity/version, destination and payload digest. IdP rendering presents the canonical operation and clearly separated script context. Keep batch and asynchronous owner decisions in the shared IdP/ape-shell flow.

Document the real provider preflight-to-move race and preserve existing protections. Test that generic invocation, agent tools, HTTP/provider access and broad grants cannot skip the protected mail command under the existing trust model.
acceptance: Synthetic changed mail is skipped; wrong identity/version/destination refuses; uncertain mutation cannot replay, including from another Pod. Provider receipts remain inspectable.
A mail behavior or approval-label change ships through a tool/recipe/IdP update without changing the Pods binary.
milestones.rollback: Version tools, adapters and recipes together; pause affected work if compatibility fails. Preserve authoritative effect state.

milestones.title: Migrate decisions and remove parallel authorization
milestones.goal: Retire Pods-specific grants without losing consent boundaries or execution history.
steps: Provide an explicit old-to-new state mapping for collecting/requested/approved/denied/expired/consumed/withdrawn/unknown records and archive manifests. Do not reinterpret pods-graph-gate approval as permission for another command. Preserve historical decisions read-only; open work is re-requested through the new exact-command flow where old authority cannot be carried safely.

Migrate active script callers, bindings and data using draft → validate → activate. Remove access.approval, program.run/mail.archive grant enums, mail ports, custom authorities and runtime-specific grant consumption. Retain only generic decision display, references and effect recovery; keep legacy readers as non-executable migration code.
acceptance: Migration rehearsal preserves counts, operation identity and every unresolved/consumed state. Unknown outcomes stay held, consumed work stays non-executable, and pending decisions remain visible without duplicate requests.
No executable Pods path uses custom mail or program approval semantics after cutover.
milestones.rollback: Use backup plus an execution-record reconciliation procedure. An old build must refuse a newer incompatible state; rollback may stop work but must never replay consumed effects.

milestones.title: Verify, release and close the migration
milestones.goal: Demonstrate the boundary on the packaged app and publish reproducible evidence.
steps: Run focused tests first, then the required affected unit gate and application builds; use native tests only for actual sandbox/process/PTY/package boundaries and browser tests for IdP rendering. Publish actual results through Reports Test Runs.

Release compatible IdP/ape-shell/mail-tool contracts before the desktop cutover, following existing relay-first rules if relay contracts change. Back up and quiesce affected work; install and migrate only within the separately authorized rollout. Verify naturally resumed work without sending test messages or moving real mail as a shortcut.
acceptance: Every safety-matrix row has recorded evidence; the packaged app has no direct alternative program path; compatible old records remain inspectable; native issue, plan and release evidence identify the actual SHAs and artifacts.
milestones.rollback: Pause affected scheduling and restore compatible software with reconciled current state. Keep unresolved effects held; do not downgrade data blindly.

risks.title: Broad shell grants or bootstrap recursion
risks.mitigation: Bind exact requests before execution; reject widening and uncontrolled fallback. Native supervisor, ape-shell bootstrap and authentication helpers are fixed trusted infrastructure, cannot accept arbitrary Pod commands and are separately audited.

risks.title: Mail safety weakens during relocation
risks.mitigation: Move checks together with mutation capability. Register the protected archive command in the mail adapter and prevent broad ordinary grants from bypassing its per-object conditions. Preserve existing provider race limitations honestly; do not promise an atomic move where the provider does not offer one.

risks.title: Restart or rollback repeats an effect
risks.mitigation: Preserve durable operation identities, consumed decisions and unknown outcomes across migration. Stop affected scheduling during cutover. Never restore a pre-effect snapshot over newer execution records; reconcile first.

risks.title: Owner reach and interpreter permissions
risks.mitigation: Keep the existing trust model explicit. A permitted interpreter or shell can create children within its granted sandbox; moving the entry point does not create syscall-level interception. Do not widen capabilities to make tests or migration pass.

verification: Use existing apes program-authorization/shell tests, Pods programs/broker/sandbox/recovery/data suites and IdP grants-authorize tests. Add parameterized refusal cases and native boundary tests where behavior crosses processes; do not introduce another test runner.

For each entry point assert approved execution exactly once, and no process/effect on denial, pending timeout, revoked/expired grant, IdP failure, identity mismatch, changed argv or changed executable. Record exit codes, process markers and grant/effect records, not only model narration.

Exercise quotes, empty/Unicode arguments, dollars, newlines, redirects and compound commands; test runtime prefixes, cache arguments, working directory and environment. None may silently change the command or gain a session grant.

Use synthetic mail and an isolated provider fixture for changed content, sender/subject mismatch, move refusal, confirmed receipt, lost response and crash/restart. No live mail mutation is required for automated acceptance.
Render IdP approval states with real browser CSS; inspect screenshots before publishing actual evidence under Test Runs. This plan records source findings only, not passed implementation tests.

completion.summary: Implementation has not started. Source findings support the proposal; runtime behavior and migration remain to be verified.

handoff: Review proposal revision 2. After approval, create a canonical native development issue and dedicated feature worktree, link this plan without duplicating its lifecycle, and start M0 then M1. M1 must settle the -c contract before the remaining migration is implemented. Record actual installed versions and active recipes before any operational change.

changelog.text: Created revision 1 from source tracing and owner direction; incorporated the request to make ape-shell -c a simple forwarding interface and clarified the difference from bash -c.

Revision 2 clarifies the owner-requested interpreter contract: Node and other interpreters are allowed, while authorization binds the concrete invocation including inline code or script content. Added explicit acceptance cases for changed code and same-path script replacement. Implementation remains unapproved.

Pods übergibt Programm/argv, zugewiesene Identität, Zielhost, Arbeitsverzeichnis, begrenzte Umgebung und Sandbox-Kontext. ape-shell übernimmt Autorisierung, Tokenprüfung, Verbrauch einmaliger Grants und den Übergang zur Prozessausführung; Pods beobachtet den Fortschritt und protokolliert generische Effekte. Der vertrauenswürdige Kontrollkanal bleibt von Programm-stdout getrennt, damit Kindprozessausgaben keinen autorisierten/nicht gestarteten Beleg fälschen können.

`-c` ist der bevorzugte öffentliche Einstieg, noch kein bereits ausreichender Sicherheitsvertrag. Ein maschineller Auftrag muss auch bei Shell-Zeichen in Argumenten ein exakter Programmauftrag bleiben. Zuerst sichere Textkodierung erproben; erfüllt sie den Vertrag nicht, einen strukturierten Auftrag über denselben Einstieg/Kern verwenden. Ein Shell-Textauftrag wird ausdrücklich als solcher typisiert und autorisiert. Die endgültige Flag-Syntax wird erst in M1 festgelegt.

`bash -c` interpretiert und startet nur Shell-Text. ape-shell ergänzt die Autorisierung; intern kann es ein Programm direkt starten oder ausdrücklich genehmigten Shell-Text mit Bash ausführen. Interpreter wie Node sind erlaubt. Die Freigabe muss den konkreten Aufruf einschließlich Interpreter-Identität, exakter Argumente und des tatsächlich auszuführenden Inline-Codes beziehungsweise Skriptinhalts abdecken. Bei `node -e "console.log(2 + 2)"` ist der Code Teil der freigegebenen Argumente. Bei `node script.js` muss zusätzlich der Skriptinhalt gebunden sein, etwa durch einen geprüften Inhaltshash; nur Interpreter-Binärdatei und Skriptpfad zu autorisieren reicht nicht. Geänderter Inline-Code oder Skriptinhalt ist nicht von der bisherigen Freigabe des exakten Aufrufs gedeckt. Die Bindung bei der Ausführung prüfen, damit eine Dateiänderung nach der Freigabe keinen ungenehmigten Code unterschieben kann. Auch ein nativer Wrapper wie sandbox-exec muss die Bindung an das tatsächliche Zielprogramm erhalten.

Mailprogramme übernehmen fachliche Vorprüfung und Effekte. Der IdP stellt die vom Adapter aufgelöste kanonische Absicht plus klar gekennzeichneten Skriptkontext dar; Textänderungen verändern niemals den autorisierten Befehl. Nicht blockierende Anfragen, Sammelentscheidungen und Fortschrittsmeldungen bleiben über den gemeinsamen ape-shell-/IdP-Vertrag verfügbar, nicht über Pods-eigene Grants.

entries.source: Safeguards and their future owners
entries.text: Absicherungen und ihre künftigen Zuständigkeiten

entries.source:
| Existing safeguard | Future owner and proof |
|---|---|
| Pod identity, owner/broker binding, audience, host and expiry | IdP issues; ape-shell verifies. Wrong identity/host/issuer and stale tokens refuse execution. |
| Exact argv, program hash, runtime and entry-file binding | Shared ape-shell execution contract plus trusted sandbox launcher. Changed file, runtime, argument or symlink refuses before start; preserve or strengthen current race protection. |
| Assigned applications, capabilities, directories and network reach | Pods supplies generic resource constraints; native sandbox enforces. ape-shell cannot expand them. |
| Single-use authorization and concurrent duplicate calls | IdP consumption plus ape-shell; durable generic operation identity in Pods prevents replay. |
| Per-message/object authorization | Mail command includes canonical object/version intent; IdP binds it and ape-shell enforces it. Broad read/program grants cannot substitute. |
| Fresh mail content, sender, subject, source folder and destination | Mail program/recipe checks immediately before mutation; stale or mismatched mail remains unchanged. |
| Receipt validation and mailbox-wide unresolved moves | Mail tool preserves provider receipts and durable message-level reconciliation across Pods and versions. Generic Pods ledger retains unknown outcomes. |
| No automatic retry after uncertain writes | Generic effect ledger before dispatch; interrupted, timed-out or failed writes stay unknown until reconciled. |
| Grant revocation, cancellation and long-running processes | Shared ape-shell lifecycle with native process-tree supervision; preserve current revocation checks and bounded token reuse. |
| Secret isolation, output bounds and failure reporting | Generic credential context and supervisor; no owner-auth fallback, token leakage or truncated successful result. |

No new generic API may accept `approved: true` from a Pod or treat its self-declared effect classification as authority. IdP-authorized semantics determine read/write classification; unknown commands are conservatively writes.
entries.text:
| Bestehende Absicherung | Künftige Zuständigkeit und Nachweis |
|---|---|
| Pod-Identität, Eigentümer-/Broker-Bindung, Audience, Host und Ablauf | IdP stellt aus; ape-shell prüft. Falsche Identität/Host/Issuer und veraltete Tokens verhindern die Ausführung. |
| Exakte argv, Programmhash, Runtime- und Einstiegsdateibindung | Gemeinsamer ape-shell-Ausführungsvertrag plus vertrauenswürdiger Sandbox-Starter. Geänderte Datei, Runtime, Argumente oder Symlink verhindern den Start; bisherigen Race-Schutz erhalten oder verbessern. |
| Zugewiesene Programme, Fähigkeiten, Verzeichnisse und Netzwerkreichweite | Pods liefert generische Ressourcengrenzen; die native Sandbox erzwingt sie. ape-shell darf sie nicht erweitern. |
| Einmalige Autorisierung und konkurrierende Doppelaufrufe | IdP-Verbrauch plus ape-shell; dauerhafte generische Vorgangsidentität in Pods verhindert Wiederholung. |
| Freigabe pro Nachricht/Objekt | Mailbefehl enthält kanonische Objekt-/Versionsabsicht; IdP bindet sie, ape-shell setzt sie durch. Breite Lese-/Programm-Grants dürfen sie nicht ersetzen. |
| Frischer Mailinhalt, Absender, Betreff, Quellordner und Ziel | Mailprogramm/Rezept prüft unmittelbar vor der Änderung; veraltete oder abweichende Mail bleibt unverändert. |
| Belegprüfung und postfachweite unklare Verschiebungen | Mailprogramm erhält Anbieterbelege und dauerhaften Abgleich pro Nachricht über Pods und Versionen hinweg. Generisches Pods-Protokoll erhält unklare Ergebnisse. |
| Keine automatische Wiederholung unklarer Schreibvorgänge | Generisches Effektprotokoll vor dem Versand; unterbrochene, abgelaufene oder fehlgeschlagene Schreibvorgänge bleiben bis zum Abgleich unklar. |
| Grant-Widerruf, Abbruch und lang laufende Prozesse | Gemeinsamer ape-shell-Lebenszyklus mit nativer Prozessbaumüberwachung; bestehende Widerrufsprüfungen und begrenzte Tokenwiederverwendung erhalten. |
| Geheimnistrennung, Ausgabegrenzen und Fehlerbericht | Generischer Credential-Kontext und Prozessüberwachung; kein Rückfall auf Eigentümer-Login, kein Tokenleck und kein abgeschnittenes Erfolgsergebnis. |

Keine neue generische API darf `approved: true` von einem Pod annehmen oder dessen eigene Effektklassifikation als Autorität behandeln. Vom IdP autorisierte Semantik bestimmt Lesen/Schreiben; unbekannte Befehle gelten vorsichtshalber als schreibend.

entries.source: Source map and implementation order
entries.text: Quellenkarte und Umsetzungsreihenfolge

entries.source:
Baseline paths in `openape-monorepo`:

- Pods approvals and domain logic: `apps/openape-pods/src/contracts/approvals.ts`, `src/worker/data/approvals.ts`, `src/worker/data/mail-archive.ts`, `src/main/gates/`, `src/main/mail/`, `src/worker/mail/`, `src/worker/runs/dispatcher.ts`, `src/worker/master/reference.ts`.
- Execution: `apps/openape-pods/src/main/programs/`, `src/main/broker/`, `src/main/shell/`, `src/worker/runtime/`, `src/runtime/shell-client.ts`; `packages/agent-runtime/src/agent-tools/ape-shell-exec.ts`.
- ape-shell: `packages/apes/src/commands/run.ts`, `src/shell/grant-dispatch.ts`, `src/shell/program-line.ts`, `src/authorization/program.ts`, `src/authorization/execute.ts`.
- IdP: `modules/nuxt-auth-idp/src/runtime/server/api/grants/authorize.post.ts`, `src/runtime/server/utils/program-authorize.ts`, grant summary/rendering and the production IdP app.
- Mail distribution clues: `apps/openape-pods/runtime-sources/o365-cli.json`, `scripts/o365-runtime.mjs`, examples and test adapters. These are not proof of the canonical external mail source; resolve it in M0 and read that repository's instructions.

Dependency order: M0 → M1 → M2/M3 → M4 → M5. M2 and M3 can be separate PR increments; no dual active authorization route may be left as a permanent compatibility mechanism. Protocol-relevant contract changes require comparison with the canonical protocol specification before implementation. No protocol change is assumed approved by this plan request.
entries.text:
Ausgangspfade in `openape-monorepo`:

- Pods-Freigaben und Fachlogik: `apps/openape-pods/src/contracts/approvals.ts`, `src/worker/data/approvals.ts`, `src/worker/data/mail-archive.ts`, `src/main/gates/`, `src/main/mail/`, `src/worker/mail/`, `src/worker/runs/dispatcher.ts`, `src/worker/master/reference.ts`.
- Ausführung: `apps/openape-pods/src/main/programs/`, `src/main/broker/`, `src/main/shell/`, `src/worker/runtime/`, `src/runtime/shell-client.ts`; `packages/agent-runtime/src/agent-tools/ape-shell-exec.ts`.
- ape-shell: `packages/apes/src/commands/run.ts`, `src/shell/grant-dispatch.ts`, `src/shell/program-line.ts`, `src/authorization/program.ts`, `src/authorization/execute.ts`.
- IdP: `modules/nuxt-auth-idp/src/runtime/server/api/grants/authorize.post.ts`, `src/runtime/server/utils/program-authorize.ts`, Grant-Zusammenfassung/-Darstellung und die produktive IdP-App.
- Hinweise zur Mail-Auslieferung: `apps/openape-pods/runtime-sources/o365-cli.json`, `scripts/o365-runtime.mjs`, Beispiele und Testadapter. Diese beweisen nicht die kanonische externe Mailquelle; in M0 bestimmen und deren Repository-Anweisungen lesen.

Abhängigkeiten: M0 → M1 → M2/M3 → M4 → M5. M2 und M3 können getrennte PR-Schritte bilden; kein zweiter aktiver Autorisierungspfad darf als dauerhafte Kompatibilitätslösung bleiben. Protokollrelevante Vertragsänderungen vor der Umsetzung mit der kanonischen Spezifikation vergleichen. Der Planauftrag gilt nicht als Freigabe einer Protokolländerung.

entries.source: Commands, working state and approval boundary
entries.text: Befehle, Arbeitsstand und Freigabegrenze

entries.source:
In every implementation shell start from the selected worktree:

```sh
. ./scripts/activate-node.sh
pnpm run doctor
```

Select existing focused suites after M0. Confirmed Pods scripts include `pnpm --filter @openape/pods test:fast`, `pnpm --filter @openape/pods build` and `pnpm --filter @openape/pods test:boundaries` (native). Run the required `pnpm check:affected --base origin/main --head HEAD --suite unit` once at the pre-push gate; do not duplicate the full gate during every iteration. A deployment requires `pnpm check:ci`. CI automation remains paused under the existing owner decision; do not reactivate it.

Plan source: `.claude/plans/2026-10-15-pods-ape-shell/plan.json`. Render with `ape-report-render plan INPUT.json OUTPUT.html --json`; publish privately in category Plans, retaining the same document for revisions and the read expected version. Record actual implementation approval against the reviewed proposal revision. The owner's architectural instruction is recorded as a decision, not as approval of this newly authored proposal.

Estimated scope: several implementation increments across CLI, desktop, IdP and mail tools. A reliable effort estimate follows M0/M1 because the active recipe migration and current shell contract are not yet measured.
entries.text:
Jede Umsetzungsshell beginnt im ausgewählten Worktree mit:

```sh
. ./scripts/activate-node.sh
pnpm run doctor
```

Bestehende fokussierte Suiten nach M0 auswählen. Bestätigte Pods-Skripte sind `pnpm --filter @openape/pods test:fast`, `pnpm --filter @openape/pods build` und `pnpm --filter @openape/pods test:boundaries` (nativ). Das erforderliche `pnpm check:affected --base origin/main --head HEAD --suite unit` einmal am Pre-push-Gate ausführen; das vollständige Gate nicht bei jeder Iteration wiederholen. Ein Deployment erfordert `pnpm check:ci`. Die CI-Automatik bleibt gemäß bestehender Eigentümerentscheidung pausiert; nicht reaktivieren.

Planquelle: `.claude/plans/2026-10-15-pods-ape-shell/plan.json`. Mit `ape-report-render plan INPUT.json OUTPUT.html --json` rendern; privat in Kategorie Plans veröffentlichen, für Revisionen dasselbe Dokument und dessen gelesene erwartete Version behalten. Tatsächliche Umsetzungsfreigabe an die geprüfte Vorschlagsrevision binden. Die Architekturvorgabe des Eigentümers ist als Entscheidung festgehalten, nicht als Freigabe dieses neu verfassten Vorschlags.

Geschätzter Umfang: mehrere Umsetzungsschritte über CLI, Desktop, IdP und Mailprogramme. Eine belastbare Aufwandsschätzung folgt M0/M1, da aktive Rezeptmigration und aktueller Shell-Vertrag noch nicht vermessen sind.

entries.source: Inventory execution paths and migration state
entries.text: Ausführungspfade und Migrationsstand erfassen

entries.source: Establish a complete boundary map and a safeguard baseline before implementation.
entries.text: Vor der Umsetzung eine vollständige Grenzkarte und einen Ausgangsstand der Absicherungen erstellen.

entries.source: Trace callers of spawn/exec, launchSandbox, launchTerminal, tools.invoke, agent tools, program.run, mail.archive and mail.next/commit, including master/runtime/dependency helpers. Classify every entry as a Pod-controlled execution or fixed infrastructure bootstrap with an explicit reason.
entries.text: Aufrufer von spawn/exec, launchSandbox, launchTerminal, tools.invoke, Agent-Werkzeugen, program.run, mail.archive und mail.next/commit einschließlich Master-/Runtime-/Abhängigkeitshelfern verfolgen. Jeden Einstieg als Pod-gesteuerte Ausführung oder festen Infrastrukturstart mit ausdrücklicher Begründung klassifizieren.

entries.source: Read installed build versions and active recipe/resource metadata without running Pods. Inventory open, consumed and unknown approvals/effects, legacy archives, data schemas and API consumers. Identify the maintained mail-tool source and repository before moving code.
entries.text: Installierte Build-Versionen und aktive Rezept-/Ressourcenmetadaten lesen, ohne Pods auszuführen. Offene, verbrauchte und unklare Freigaben/Effekte, alte Archive, Datenschemata und API-Nutzer erfassen. Die gepflegte Quelle und das Repository des Mailprogramms vor der Codeverlagerung bestimmen.

entries.source: Every discovered process entry and each existing safeguard has an owner, test and migration disposition; no unknown path is silently exempted.
entries.text: Jeder gefundene Prozesseinstieg und jede bestehende Absicherung hat Zuständigkeit, Test und Migrationsentscheidung; kein unbekannter Pfad wird still ausgenommen.

entries.source: Read-only inventory; preserve original records and avoid executing scheduled work.
entries.text: Nur lesende Erfassung; Originalprotokolle erhalten und keine geplante Arbeit ausführen.

entries.source: Prove simple forwarding through ape-shell -c
entries.text: Einfaches Weiterreichen über ape-shell -c nachweisen

entries.source: Make one exact program request use ape-shell authorization and sandboxed execution end to end.
entries.text: Einen exakten Programmauftrag durchgängig über ape-shell autorisieren und in der Sandbox ausführen.

entries.source: Extend the existing -c path using packages/apes/src/authorization/program.ts and execute.ts. Define a versioned machine request/result contract and a trusted progress channel; support pending, refused, not-started, started and unknown outcomes. Prefer existing CLI behavior; add structured transport only if the argument tests require it.
entries.text: Den bestehenden -c-Pfad mit packages/apes/src/authorization/program.ts und execute.ts erweitern. Einen versionierten Maschinenauftrag/-ergebnisvertrag und vertrauenswürdigen Fortschrittskanal definieren; pending, refused, not-started, started und unknown unterstützen. Bestehendes CLI-Verhalten bevorzugen; strukturierten Transport nur ergänzen, wenn die Argumenttests ihn erfordern.

entries.source: Prototype runtime-prefix and entry-file binding, Pod identity/broker claims, cwd/env, sandbox policy, output limits, PTY, cancellation and descendant termination. Reuse one authorization core for interactive and machine entry points; no preauthorization boolean from Pods.
entries.text: Bindung von Runtime-Präfix und Einstiegsdateien, Pod-Identität/Broker-Claims, cwd/env, Sandbox-Regeln, Ausgabegrenzen, PTY, Abbruch und Beendigung von Kindprozessen erproben. Einen Autorisierungskern für interaktive und maschinelle Einstiege verwenden; kein Vorabfreigabe-Boolean aus Pods.

entries.source: A synthetic program runs exactly once after approval. Denied, unanswered, timed-out, malformed, revoked and mismatched requests create neither the process marker nor the effect. Shell punctuation in a literal argument never requests wider authority.
entries.text: Ein synthetisches Programm läuft nach Freigabe genau einmal. Abgelehnte, unbeantwortete, abgelaufene, fehlerhafte, widerrufene und abweichende Aufträge erzeugen weder Prozessmarker noch Effekt. Shell-Zeichen in einem wörtlichen Argument fordern nie breitere Rechte an.

entries.source: Record the final -c syntax and transport decision with native execution evidence. If the approach cannot preserve the safety matrix, revise this plan before proceeding.
entries.text: Endgültige -c-Syntax und Transportentscheidung mit nativen Ausführungsnachweisen festhalten. Kann der Ansatz die Schutzmatrix nicht erhalten, diesen Plan vor dem Fortfahren überarbeiten.

entries.source: Keep the prototype isolated and leave installed Pods unchanged.
entries.text: Den Prototyp isoliert halten und installierte Pods unverändert lassen.

entries.source: Route every program entry through the shared core
entries.text: Jeden Programmeinstieg über den gemeinsamen Kern führen

entries.source: Reduce Pods to generic forwarding, resource boundaries and effect supervision.
entries.text: Pods auf generische Weiterleitung, Ressourcengrenzen und Effektüberwachung reduzieren.

entries.source: Replace direct program authorization and launch paths in broker/tools.ts, programs/invoke.ts, programs/session.ts, shell/session.ts, worker runners and agent-tool bridges. Preserve assigned application selection, runtime verification and sandbox enforcement. Route helper programs and runtime work according to M0; keep fixed bootstrap infrastructure non-programmable.
entries.text: Direkte Programmautorisierungs- und Startpfade in broker/tools.ts, programs/invoke.ts, programs/session.ts, shell/session.ts, Worker-Runnern und Agent-Werkzeugbrücken ersetzen. Auswahl zugewiesener Programme, Runtime-Prüfung und Sandbox-Durchsetzung erhalten. Hilfsprogramme und Runtime-Arbeit gemäß M0 umstellen; feste Startinfrastruktur nicht programmierbar halten.

entries.source: Use opaque operation IDs and authenticated lifecycle results for the generic effect ledger. Preserve pending/resume, concurrent once-use, crash recovery, revocation behavior and conservative handling of unknown writes.
entries.text: Undurchsichtige Vorgangs-IDs und authentifizierte Lebenszyklusergebnisse für das generische Effektprotokoll verwenden. Warten/Fortsetzen, konkurrierenden Einmalverbrauch, Wiederherstellung nach Absturz, Widerrufsverhalten und vorsichtige Behandlung unklarer Schreibvorgänge erhalten.

entries.source: Each M0 entry point passes both success and refusal tests through ape-shell. A structural check rejects new direct user-program launch or authorization paths in Pods.
entries.text: Jeder M0-Einstieg besteht Erfolgs- und Ablehnungstests über ape-shell. Eine Strukturprüfung lehnt neue direkte Start- oder Autorisierungspfade für Nutzerprogramme in Pods ab.

entries.source: Before production cutover, retain a tested old build for whole-version recovery; never add an automatic per-call fallback to the old path.
entries.text: Vor der Produktionsumstellung einen geprüften alten Build für die Rückkehr als ganze Version behalten; niemals einen automatischen Ausweichpfad pro Aufruf zur alten Logik hinzufügen.

entries.source: Relocate mail behavior and IdP presentation
entries.text: Mail-Verhalten und IdP-Darstellung verlagern

entries.source: Preserve mail functionality and object-level protection without desktop domain code.
entries.text: Mail-Funktion und objektbezogenen Schutz ohne Fachcode im Desktop erhalten.

entries.source: Move archival preflight, provider parsing, receipts, object/version checks and mailbox-wide reconciliation to the maintained mail tool. Move mail intake, extraction, classification and orchestration to mail tools/recipes; use generic data and execution APIs from Pods. Avoid merely renaming mail code or bundling it back into the desktop.
entries.text: Archivierungs-Vorprüfung, Anbieterparsing, Belege, Objekt-/Versionsprüfungen und postfachweiten Abgleich in das gepflegte Mailprogramm verlagern. Maileingang, Extraktion, Klassifikation und Orchestrierung in Mailprogramme/Rezepte verschieben; generische Daten- und Ausführungs-APIs von Pods verwenden. Mailcode nicht bloß umbenennen oder wieder in den Desktop einbauen.

entries.source: Define adapter commands that bind mailbox, message identity/version, destination and payload digest. IdP rendering presents the canonical operation and clearly separated script context. Keep batch and asynchronous owner decisions in the shared IdP/ape-shell flow.
entries.text: Adapterbefehle definieren, die Postfach, Nachrichtenidentität/-version, Ziel und Payload-Digest binden. IdP-Darstellung zeigt die kanonische Operation und klar getrennten Skriptkontext. Sammel- und asynchrone Eigentümerentscheidungen im gemeinsamen IdP-/ape-shell-Ablauf erhalten.

entries.source: Document the real provider preflight-to-move race and preserve existing protections. Test that generic invocation, agent tools, HTTP/provider access and broad grants cannot skip the protected mail command under the existing trust model.
entries.text: Das tatsächliche Zeitfenster zwischen Anbieter-Vorprüfung und Move dokumentieren und bestehende Absicherungen erhalten. Prüfen, dass generische Aufrufe, Agent-Werkzeuge, HTTP-/Anbieterzugriff und breite Grants den geschützten Mailbefehl im bestehenden Vertrauensmodell nicht überspringen können.

entries.source: Synthetic changed mail is skipped; wrong identity/version/destination refuses; uncertain mutation cannot replay, including from another Pod. Provider receipts remain inspectable.
entries.text: Geänderte synthetische Mail wird übersprungen; falsche Identität/Version/Ziel werden abgewiesen; unklare Änderungen können auch aus einem anderen Pod nicht wiederholt werden. Anbieterbelege bleiben prüfbar.

entries.source: A mail behavior or approval-label change ships through a tool/recipe/IdP update without changing the Pods binary.
entries.text: Eine Mail-Verhaltens- oder Freigabebeschriftungsänderung wird über Programm/Rezept/IdP ausgeliefert, ohne die Pods-Binärdatei zu ändern.

entries.source: Version tools, adapters and recipes together; pause affected work if compatibility fails. Preserve authoritative effect state.
entries.text: Programme, Adapter und Rezepte gemeinsam versionieren; bei Inkompatibilität betroffene Arbeit anhalten. Maßgeblichen Effektzustand erhalten.

entries.source: Migrate decisions and remove parallel authorization
entries.text: Entscheidungen migrieren und parallele Freigabelogik entfernen

entries.source: Retire Pods-specific grants without losing consent boundaries or execution history.
entries.text: Pods-spezifische Grants stilllegen, ohne Zustimmungsgrenzen oder Ausführungshistorie zu verlieren.

entries.source: Provide an explicit old-to-new state mapping for collecting/requested/approved/denied/expired/consumed/withdrawn/unknown records and archive manifests. Do not reinterpret pods-graph-gate approval as permission for another command. Preserve historical decisions read-only; open work is re-requested through the new exact-command flow where old authority cannot be carried safely.
entries.text: Eine ausdrückliche Alt-neu-Zuordnung für collecting/requested/approved/denied/expired/consumed/withdrawn/unknown-Datensätze und Archivmanifeste erstellen. pods-graph-gate-Freigaben nicht als Berechtigung für einen anderen Befehl umdeuten. Historische Entscheidungen lesbar erhalten; offene Arbeit über den neuen exakten Kommandopfad erneut anfragen, wenn alte Berechtigung nicht sicher übernommen werden kann.

entries.source: Migrate active script callers, bindings and data using draft → validate → activate. Remove access.approval, program.run/mail.archive grant enums, mail ports, custom authorities and runtime-specific grant consumption. Retain only generic decision display, references and effect recovery; keep legacy readers as non-executable migration code.
entries.text: Aktive Skriptaufrufer, Bindungen und Daten über draft → validate → activate migrieren. access.approval, program.run/mail.archive-Grant-Enums, Mailports, eigene Authorities und Runtime-spezifischen Grant-Verbrauch entfernen. Nur generische Entscheidungsanzeige, Referenzen und Effektwiederherstellung behalten; Altleser als nicht ausführbaren Migrationscode erhalten.

entries.source: Migration rehearsal preserves counts, operation identity and every unresolved/consumed state. Unknown outcomes stay held, consumed work stays non-executable, and pending decisions remain visible without duplicate requests.
entries.text: Migrationsprobe erhält Anzahlen, Vorgangsidentität und jeden ungeklärten/verbrauchten Zustand. Unklare Ergebnisse bleiben angehalten, verbrauchte Arbeit bleibt unausführbar und offene Entscheidungen sichtbar, ohne doppelte Anfragen.

entries.source: No executable Pods path uses custom mail or program approval semantics after cutover.
entries.text: Nach der Umstellung nutzt kein ausführbarer Pods-Pfad eigene Mail- oder Programmfreigabesemantik.

entries.source: Use backup plus an execution-record reconciliation procedure. An old build must refuse a newer incompatible state; rollback may stop work but must never replay consumed effects.
entries.text: Backup plus Abgleichverfahren für Ausführungsprotokolle verwenden. Ein alter Build muss neueren inkompatiblen Zustand ablehnen; Rücknahme darf Arbeit stoppen, aber nie verbrauchte Effekte wiederholen.

entries.source: Verify, release and close the migration
entries.text: Prüfen, ausliefern und Migration abschließen

entries.source: Demonstrate the boundary on the packaged app and publish reproducible evidence.
entries.text: Die Grenze an der paketierten App nachweisen und reproduzierbare Belege veröffentlichen.

entries.source: Run focused tests first, then the required affected unit gate and application builds; use native tests only for actual sandbox/process/PTY/package boundaries and browser tests for IdP rendering. Publish actual results through Reports Test Runs.
entries.text: Zuerst fokussierte Tests, dann das erforderliche betroffene Unit-Gate und Anwendungsbuilds ausführen; native Tests nur für tatsächliche Sandbox-/Prozess-/PTY-/Paketgrenzen und Browsertests für die IdP-Darstellung verwenden. Tatsächliche Ergebnisse über Reports Test Runs veröffentlichen.

entries.source: Release compatible IdP/ape-shell/mail-tool contracts before the desktop cutover, following existing relay-first rules if relay contracts change. Back up and quiesce affected work; install and migrate only within the separately authorized rollout. Verify naturally resumed work without sending test messages or moving real mail as a shortcut.
entries.text: Kompatible IdP-/ape-shell-/Mailprogramm-Verträge vor der Desktop-Umstellung ausliefern; bei geänderten Relay-Verträgen die bestehenden Relay-first-Regeln einhalten. Betroffene Arbeit sichern und anhalten; Installation und Migration nur innerhalb des gesondert freigegebenen Rollouts durchführen. Regulär wiederaufgenommene Arbeit prüfen, ohne Testnachrichten oder echte Mailverschiebungen als Abkürzung zu verwenden.

entries.source: Every safety-matrix row has recorded evidence; the packaged app has no direct alternative program path; compatible old records remain inspectable; native issue, plan and release evidence identify the actual SHAs and artifacts.
entries.text: Jede Zeile der Schutzmatrix hat aufgezeichnete Nachweise; die paketierte App besitzt keinen direkten alternativen Programmpfad; kompatible Altprotokolle bleiben prüfbar; natives Issue, Plan und Release-Nachweise benennen tatsächliche SHAs und Artefakte.

entries.source: Pause affected scheduling and restore compatible software with reconciled current state. Keep unresolved effects held; do not downgrade data blindly.
entries.text: Betroffene Zeitpläne anhalten und kompatible Software mit abgeglichenem aktuellem Zustand wiederherstellen. Unklare Effekte angehalten lassen; Daten nicht blind zurückstufen.

entries.source: Broad shell grants or bootstrap recursion
entries.text: Breite Shell-Freigaben oder rekursive Startpfade

entries.source: Bind exact requests before execution; reject widening and uncontrolled fallback. Native supervisor, ape-shell bootstrap and authentication helpers are fixed trusted infrastructure, cannot accept arbitrary Pod commands and are separately audited.
entries.text: Exakte Aufträge vor der Ausführung binden; Erweiterungen und unkontrollierte Ausweichpfade ablehnen. Native Prozessüberwachung, ape-shell-Start und Authentifizierungshelfer sind feste vertrauenswürdige Infrastruktur, dürfen keine beliebigen Pod-Befehle annehmen und werden separat geprüft.

entries.source: Mail safety weakens during relocation
entries.text: Mail-Schutz wird bei der Verlagerung schwächer

entries.source: Move checks together with mutation capability. Register the protected archive command in the mail adapter and prevent broad ordinary grants from bypassing its per-object conditions. Preserve existing provider race limitations honestly; do not promise an atomic move where the provider does not offer one.
entries.text: Prüfungen zusammen mit der Schreibfähigkeit verlagern. Den geschützten Archivierungsbefehl im Mailadapter registrieren und verhindern, dass breite normale Grants dessen objektbezogene Bedingungen umgehen. Bestehende Race-Limits des Anbieters ehrlich erhalten; keinen atomaren Move versprechen, wenn der Anbieter ihn nicht unterstützt.

entries.source: Restart or rollback repeats an effect
entries.text: Neustart oder Rücknahme wiederholt einen Effekt

entries.source: Preserve durable operation identities, consumed decisions and unknown outcomes across migration. Stop affected scheduling during cutover. Never restore a pre-effect snapshot over newer execution records; reconcile first.
entries.text: Dauerhafte Vorgangsidentitäten, verbrauchte Entscheidungen und unklare Ergebnisse über die Migration hinweg erhalten. Betroffene Zeitpläne während der Umstellung anhalten. Niemals einen Stand vor einem Effekt über neuere Ausführungsprotokolle zurückspielen; zuerst abgleichen.

entries.source: Owner reach and interpreter permissions
entries.text: Owner-Reichweite und Interpreter-Berechtigungen

entries.source: Keep the existing trust model explicit. A permitted interpreter or shell can create children within its granted sandbox; moving the entry point does not create syscall-level interception. Do not widen capabilities to make tests or migration pass.
entries.text: Das bestehende Vertrauensmodell ausdrücklich beibehalten. Ein erlaubter Interpreter oder eine Shell kann innerhalb ihrer Sandbox Kindprozesse erzeugen; ein verlegter Einstieg erzeugt keine Kontrolle auf Systemaufrufebene. Fähigkeiten nicht erweitern, damit Tests oder Migration durchlaufen.

entries.source: Use existing apes program-authorization/shell tests, Pods programs/broker/sandbox/recovery/data suites and IdP grants-authorize tests. Add parameterized refusal cases and native boundary tests where behavior crosses processes; do not introduce another test runner.
entries.text: Bestehende apes-Tests für Programmautorisierung/Shell, Pods-Suiten für Programme/Broker/Sandbox/Recovery/Daten und IdP-Tests grants-authorize verwenden. Parametrisierte Ablehnungsfälle und native Grenztests für Prozessübergänge ergänzen; keinen weiteren Testrunner einführen.

entries.source: For each entry point assert approved execution exactly once, and no process/effect on denial, pending timeout, revoked/expired grant, IdP failure, identity mismatch, changed argv or changed executable. Record exit codes, process markers and grant/effect records, not only model narration.
entries.text: Für jeden Einstieg genehmigte Ausführung genau einmal und keinen Prozess/Effekt bei Ablehnung, ausstehender Freigabe mit Timeout, widerrufenem/abgelaufenem Grant, IdP-Fehler, Identitätsabweichung, geänderten argv oder geänderter Programmdatei nachweisen. Exit-Codes, Prozessmarker und Grant-/Effektprotokolle aufzeichnen, nicht nur Modellprosa.

entries.source: Exercise quotes, empty/Unicode arguments, dollars, newlines, redirects and compound commands; test runtime prefixes, cache arguments, working directory and environment. None may silently change the command or gain a session grant.
entries.text: Anführungszeichen, leere/Unicode-Argumente, Dollarzeichen, Zeilenumbrüche, Umleitungen und zusammengesetzte Befehle prüfen; Runtime-Präfixe, Cache-Argumente, Arbeitsverzeichnis und Umgebung testen. Nichts davon darf den Befehl still ändern oder eine Session-Freigabe erlangen.

entries.source: Use synthetic mail and an isolated provider fixture for changed content, sender/subject mismatch, move refusal, confirmed receipt, lost response and crash/restart. No live mail mutation is required for automated acceptance.
entries.text: Synthetische Mails und eine isolierte Anbieter-Fixture für geänderten Inhalt, abweichenden Absender/Betreff, verweigerten Move, bestätigten Beleg, verlorene Antwort und Absturz/Neustart verwenden. Automatische Abnahme erfordert keine Änderung echter Mails.

entries.source: Render IdP approval states with real browser CSS; inspect screenshots before publishing actual evidence under Test Runs. This plan records source findings only, not passed implementation tests.
entries.text: IdP-Freigabezustände im Browser mit echtem CSS darstellen; Screenshots vor der Veröffentlichung tatsächlicher Nachweise unter Test Runs prüfen. Dieser Plan hält nur Quellcodebefunde fest, keine bestandenen Umsetzungstests.

entries.source: Implementation has not started. Source findings support the proposal; runtime behavior and migration remain to be verified.
entries.text: Die Umsetzung hat nicht begonnen. Quellcodebefunde stützen den Vorschlag; Laufzeitverhalten und Migration sind noch zu prüfen.

entries.source: Review proposal revision 2. After approval, create a canonical native development issue and dedicated feature worktree, link this plan without duplicating its lifecycle, and start M0 then M1. M1 must settle the -c contract before the remaining migration is implemented. Record actual installed versions and active recipes before any operational change.
entries.text: Vorschlagsrevision 2 prüfen. Nach Freigabe ein kanonisches natives Entwicklungs-Issue und einen eigenen Feature-Worktree anlegen, diesen Plan ohne doppelten Lebenszyklus verknüpfen und mit M0, dann M1 beginnen. M1 muss den -c-Vertrag klären, bevor die restliche Migration umgesetzt wird. Tatsächlich installierte Versionen und aktive Rezepte vor jeder betrieblichen Änderung erfassen.

entries.source: Created revision 1 from source tracing and owner direction; incorporated the request to make ape-shell -c a simple forwarding interface and clarified the difference from bash -c.
entries.text: Revision 1 aus Quellcodeprüfung und Vorgabe des Eigentümers erstellt; den Wunsch nach ape-shell -c als einfacher Weiterleitung aufgenommen und den Unterschied zu bash -c geklärt.

entries.source: An approved node -e invocation executes its exact inline code. Changed inline code is refused under that approval. An approved node script.js invocation binds the script content; changed content at the same path, including replacement after approval, is refused before execution. These cases pass through the same ape-shell path as other programs.
entries.text: Ein freigegebener node -e-Aufruf führt seinen exakten Inline-Code aus. Geänderter Inline-Code wird unter dieser Freigabe abgewiesen. Ein freigegebener node script.js-Aufruf bindet den Skriptinhalt; geänderter Inhalt am selben Pfad, auch durch Austausch nach der Freigabe, wird vor der Ausführung abgewiesen. Diese Fälle laufen über denselben ape-shell-Pfad wie andere Programme.

entries.source: Revision 2 clarifies the owner-requested interpreter contract: Node and other interpreters are allowed, while authorization binds the concrete invocation including inline code or script content. Added explicit acceptance cases for changed code and same-path script replacement. Implementation remains unapproved.
entries.text: Revision 2 präzisiert auf Wunsch des Eigentümers den Interpreter-Vertrag: Node und andere Interpreter sind erlaubt; die Freigabe bindet den konkreten Aufruf einschließlich Inline-Code oder Skriptinhalt. Ausdrückliche Abnahmefälle für geänderten Code und Skriptaustausch am selben Pfad ergänzt. Die Umsetzung bleibt nicht freigegeben.
